name: say the line bart! simpsons
meaning: A classroom urges Bart to say his catchphrase; he reluctantly says it and everyone cheers. For a predictable line someone always says, delivered on demand.
when_to_use: text1 = the crowd's demand, "say the line, [name]!" (top panel). text2 = the reluctant delivery of the catchphrase (on Bart, middle). text3 = the crowd going wild (bottom panel).
